Welcome to our prototype dashboard made with Grafana and DC! We're thrilled to share with you the data we've collected and the insights we've gained from it. Our dashboard is designed to be an example of what can be achieved by the data collection framework DC for ROS 2, with interactive graphs and charts that allow you to explore the data in a user-friendly way.

Whether you're a data analyst, a business owner, or just curious about how our system works, our dashboard has something for everyone. You can dive into the data and discover trends and patterns that might not be immediately apparent, or compare different metrics to gain a deeper understanding of our system's performance.

Feel free to use this as a base, backend and/or frontend.

Current data loaded by this dashboard, backed by the DC 2.0 PostgreSQL destination (see the QR-code inspection demo, doc/src/dc/demos/qrcodes_minio_pgsql.md):

  1. Robot
    1. Command velocity and speed over time
    2. Uploaded inspection images and status (RustFS + PostgreSQL)
    3. Group completion status
